abstract: This paper studies how spillovers across complementary markets shape product variety and firm entry. We examine the Indian cell phone and wireless service markets during the 4G rollout and estimate a structural model of demand, pricing, carrier network expansion, and phone product choice. The estimation results support the economic forces through which complementarity generates spillovers. Counterfactual simulations show that banning budget Chinese phones slows 4G deployment by roughly five quarters and lowers consumer welfare without raising domestic firms' profits. Similarly, an unrestricted subsidy outperforms a domestic-only subsidy in expanding network coverage, increasing consumer welfare, and raising domestic firms' profits.
abstract_zh: 本文研究互补市场间的溢出效应如何影响产品多样性与企业进入。我们以印度4G网络部署期间的手机与无线服务市场为研究对象，构建了涵盖需求、定价、运营商网络扩张及手机产品选择的结构模型。估计结果证实了互补性产生溢出效应的经济机制。反事实模拟表明：禁止廉价中国手机将使4G部署延迟约五个季度，并降低消费者福利，但不会提升本土企业利润；同样，无限制补贴在扩大网络覆盖、提升消费者福利及增加本土企业利润方面均优于仅限本土企业的补贴方案。

title: Spillover Effects in Complementary Markets: A Study of the Indian Cell Phone and Wireless Service Markets
title_zh: 互补市场中的溢出效应：印度手机与无线服务市场研究

abstract: We study the effects of horizontal mergers on product quality in a bilateral bargaining environment. In our model, a competition‐reducing merger reduces equilibrium quality as long as the buyer's marginal rate of substitution of quality for price declines with price, holding quality constant. This condition is closely related to quality being a normal good. This result holds when price and quality are jointly negotiated, and it extends to a sequential setting in which sellers first choose quality and then bargain with buyers over price. We discuss applications to procurement and healthcare markets, as well as several extensions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究双边议价环境下横向并购对产品质量的影响。在我们的模型中，只要在质量不变的情况下，买方对质量与价格的边际替代率随价格下降而降低，那么减少竞争的并购就会降低均衡质量。这一条件与质量属于正常品密切相关。该结论在价格与质量联合谈判时成立，并可扩展至卖方先选择质量、再与买方就价格进行议价的序贯设定中。我们讨论了该结论在采购与医疗健康市场中的应用，并探讨了若干扩展情形。
title: Mergers when price and quality are set by bargaining
title_zh: 价格与质量由谈判决定时的并购

abstract: Developing countries face high pharmaceutical prices despite the presence of multiple generic producers. One key reason is excessive spending on sales and marketing by drug firms. This paper examines how centralized drug procurement can curb such marketing efforts and reduce prices, using a policy experiment in China where certain generics are procured through centralized auctions in pilot cities. Winning firms gain large market shares directly without high marketing costs. We find that the centralized auction significantly reduces both sales costs and prices, with winning firms experiencing notable decreases in marketing-related labor demand.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家尽管存在多家仿制药生产商，却仍面临高昂的药品价格。其中一个关键原因是制药企业在销售和营销上的过度支出。本文利用中国在试点城市对特定仿制药实施集中采购拍卖的政策实验，考察集中采购如何抑制此类营销行为并降低价格。中标企业无需承担高额营销成本即可直接获得较大市场份额。研究发现，集中采购拍卖显著降低了销售成本与药品价格，中标企业的营销相关劳动力需求出现明显下降。

title: Excessive Pharmaceutical Marketing Expenditure: Policy Remedies from China
title_zh: 过高的药品营销支出：来自中国的政策应对

abstract: Weather extremes shape short-run economic activity through both market and nonmarket channels, yet evidence on local consumer-side activity remains limited. Using a municipality-level panel of Portuguese data (2010–2021), we estimate panel VAR and local-projection responses to weather shocks of point-of-sale purchases (a measure of merchant-location transaction activity, not resident household consumption), together with unemployment and house prices. Our central methodological finding is that hourly rather than daily measurement of rainfall variability raises the estimated semi-elasticities by an order of magnitude, suggesting that the existing climate-economy literature systematically understates the importance of high-intensity rainfall. Substantively, the local-projection responses indicate that hourly rainfall volatility raises purchases on impact and reverses the following quarter, consistent with intertemporal reallocation; temperature variability generates a sharp positive impact effect followed by a contraction; and high fire-danger days raise contemporaneous purchases. Unemployment and house prices follow the same patterns more weakly. Regional heterogeneity is substantial, the Lisbon Metropolitan Area and the Algarve sometimes display effects opposite in sign to those in the North.
abstract_zh: 极端天气通过市场与非市场渠道影响短期经济活动，但关于本地消费者侧活动的证据仍然有限。基于葡萄牙市级面板数据（2010-2021年），我们采用面板VAR和局部投影法估计了天气冲击对销售点购买行为（衡量商户所在地交易活动，而非居民家庭消费）、失业率和房价的影响。核心方法论发现是：以小时而非日度频率测量降雨变异性，会使估计的半弹性系数提升一个数量级，表明现有气候经济学文献系统性低估了高强度降雨的重要性。从实质结果看，局部投影响应显示：小时降雨波动性在当期推高购买量，随后一个季度出现反转，符合跨期重新配置特征；温度波动性产生先急剧正向冲击后收缩的效应；高火灾风险日则提升同期购买量。失业率和房价呈现相同但更弱的模式。区域异质性显著，里斯本大都市区和阿尔加维地区有时呈现与北部地区符号相反的效应。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
title_zh: 天气冲击的区域经济影响：来自葡萄牙的证据

abstract: We study the effect of the MeToo movement on reports of sex crimes to the police. Using multiple empirical strategies, including a triple-difference design comparing crime types across countries and over time, we find that the movement increased reported sex crimes by approximately 10%. Analyzing incident-level US data, we find that the movement also increased arrests and had similar effects across racial and socioeconomic groups. The evidence suggests that the increase reflects a higher propensity to report sex crimes rather than an increase in their incidence. Our results demonstrate that social movements can rapidly and persistently change high-stakes personal decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了MeToo运动对向警方报告性犯罪的影响。通过多种实证策略（包括比较不同国家、不同时期犯罪类型的三重差分设计），我们发现该运动使报告的性犯罪数量增加了约10%。对美国事件层面数据的分析表明，该运动还提高了逮捕率，且对不同种族和社会经济群体产生了相似的影响。证据显示，这一增长反映的是性犯罪报告倾向的提高，而非性犯罪发生率的上升。我们的结果表明，社会运动能够迅速且持续地改变高风险的个体决策。
title: The Effects of Social Movements: Evidence from #MeToo
title_zh: 社会运动的影响：来自#MeToo运动的证据

abstract: Globally, one-third of food is discarded, generating lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions comparable to those from road transport. Further, waste management is among the largest municipal budget items worldwide. Exploiting plausibly exogenous unit-based food waste tax expansions in South Korea, I find that the tax substantially reduces food waste by discouraging excessive grocery purchases. Households sustain food intake despite buying less, but at the cost of additional time spent on meal production. Nonpecuniary motivations appear central to the policy’s e!ectiveness, and the tax is likely welfare-improving because more e"cient food use not only reduces externalities but also offsets time costs.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，三分之一的食物被丢弃，其产生的生命周期温室气体排放量与公路运输相当。此外，废弃物管理是全球市政预算中最大的支出项目之一。利用韩国基于单位计量的食品废弃物税扩大的准外生性变化，本研究发现该税种通过抑制过度购买行为显著减少了食品浪费。尽管家庭购买量减少，但食物摄入量得以维持，代价是增加了膳食制作的时间投入。非金钱动机对该政策的有效性至关重要，而该税种很可能提升社会福利，因为更高效的食物利用不仅减少了外部性，还抵消了时间成本。
title: Does a Food Waste Tax Work? Evidence from Quasi-Experiments in South Korea
title_zh: 食品浪费税有效吗？来自韩国准实验的证据

abstract: While the relationship between health insurance coverage and health outcomes has been extensively studied, there is limited evidence on which specific features of insurance matter. We address this gap by leveraging the abrupt termination of Colombia’s largest health insurer and examining the spillover effects on patients who were not enrolled with the terminated insurer. The termination caused a 10% decrease in the breadth of provider networks among incumbent insurers and a 20% increase in mortality rates. We show two mechanisms drove the change in mortality: increased congestion stemming from the surge of enrollees at incumbent insurers and reduced provider network breadth. Insurers narrowed their networks by excluding higher-quality providers that served sicker, more expensive patients, whoin turn died at much higher rates than their counterparts. Findings suggest insurers play a key role in patient health through their provider networks.
abstract_zh: 尽管健康保险覆盖与健康结果之间的关系已被广泛研究，但关于保险具体特征如何影响健康结果的证据仍然有限。我们利用哥伦比亚最大健康保险公司的突然终止，考察其对未参保于该终止保险公司的患者产生的溢出效应，从而填补这一研究空白。该保险公司的终止导致现有保险公司的医疗服务提供者网络广度下降10%，死亡率上升20%。我们揭示了驱动死亡率变化的两种机制：因参保者涌入现有保险公司而导致的拥堵加剧，以及医疗服务提供者网络广度的缩减。保险公司通过排除那些服务于病情更重、医疗费用更高患者的优质医疗服务提供者来收窄其网络，而这些患者的死亡率远高于其他患者。研究结果表明，保险公司通过其医疗服务提供者网络在患者健康中发挥着关键作用。
title: Do Health Insurers Matter for Health Outcomes? Evidence from a Large Natural Experiment in Colombia
title_zh: 健康保险公司对健康结果有影响吗？来自哥伦比亚一项大型自然实验的证据

abstract: This paper studies how to design experiments when the experimental units are large aggregate entities (e.g., markets), and only one or a small number of units can be treated. We propose a class of non-randomized experimental designs using the synthetic control method, which jointly selects treated units and untreated units to serve as a comparison group. We analyze the properties of estimators under these synthetic control designs and develop new inferential techniques. We show that, in experiments with aggregate units, synthetic control designs can substantially reduce estimation bias relative to randomized experiments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究当实验单元为大型聚合实体（如市场）且仅能对一个或少量单元进行干预时，如何设计实验。我们提出一类基于合成控制法的非随机化实验设计，该方法联合选择处理组单元与对照组单元作为比较组。我们分析了此类合成控制设计下估计量的性质，并开发了新的推断技术。研究表明，在聚合单元实验中，相较于随机化实验，合成控制设计能显著降低估计偏差。
title: Synthetic Controls for Experimental Design
title_zh: 实验设计的合成控制法

abstract: We identify the distributional and quantile marginal treatment effect functions when the outcome is right-censored. Our method requires a conditionally exogenous instrument and random censoring. We propose asymptotically consistent semi-parametric estimators and valid inferential procedures for the target functions . To illustrate, we evaluate the effect of alternative sentences (fines and community service vs. no punishment) on recidivism in Brazil. Our results highlight substantial treatment effect heterogeneity: we find that people whom most judges would punish take longer to recidivate, while people who would be punished only by strict judges recidivate at an earlier date than if they were not punished.
abstract_zh: 我们识别了当结果存在右删失时的分布和分位数边际处理效应函数。该方法要求工具变量条件外生且删失随机。我们提出了目标函数的渐近一致半参数估计量及有效推断程序。为进行说明，我们评估了巴西替代性刑罚（罚金与社区服务 vs. 无惩罚）对再犯率的影响。研究结果凸显了显著的处理效应异质性：多数法官倾向于施以惩罚的个体再犯间隔时间更长，而仅被严厉法官判处惩罚的个体，其再犯时间反而早于未受惩罚的情况。
title: Was Javert Right to Be Suspicious? Marginal Treatment Effects with Duration Outcomes
title_zh: 贾维特的怀疑是对的吗？持续期结果下的边际处理效应

abstract: A recent literature studies fiscal policy with realistic intertemporal marginal propensities to consume and the absence of Ricardian equivalence. This literature shows that fiscal policy boosts consumption and is effective: (i) Cumulative fiscal multipliers are above one, and (ii) fiscal policy is fully self-financing. I show this does not extend to small open economies by providing conditions where (i) the cumulative fiscal multiplier is exactly one, and (ii) fiscal deficits are not fully self-financing. This is because the initial debt-fueled rise in consumption is offset by a drop to repay foreign debt. Finally, I provide conditions to overturn this result.
abstract_zh: 近期文献在考虑现实跨期边际消费倾向且不存在李嘉图等价的前提下，研究了财政政策效应。该文献表明，财政政策能够促进消费且具有有效性：（i）累积财政乘数大于1，（ii）财政政策可实现完全自我融资。本文通过设定条件证明，这一结论并不适用于小型开放经济体：在这些条件下，（i）累积财政乘数恰好等于1，（ii）财政赤字无法实现完全自我融资。其根本原因在于，由债务驱动的初始消费增长将被偿还外债所导致的消费下降所抵消。最后，本文提出了可推翻该结论的条件。
title: Fiscal Policy in Small Open Economies: The International Intertemporal Keynesian Cross
title_zh: 小型开放经济体中的财政政策：国际跨期凯恩斯交叉

abstract: This paper reevaluates the longstanding debate on capital-labor substitution by examining the role of external inputs: raw materials, intermediate goods and services, imports, offshoring. Both a meta-analysis (analyzing existing estimates of substitution) and direct estimation (using U.S. data for 1963-2016) indicate that external inputs disproportionately displace labor. These findings imply (1) that the capital-labor ratio responds 40-80% more strongly to the price of labor than to the price of capital, (2) that value added cannot be modeled separably from gross output, and (3) that historical disagreements regarding substitution can be recast as an omitted variable bias involving external inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察外部投入（原材料、中间品与服务、进口、离岸外包）的作用，重新审视了关于资本-劳动替代的长期争论。元分析（对现有替代弹性估计值的系统性分析）与直接估计（基于1963-2016年美国数据）均表明，外部投入对劳动的替代效应尤为显著。这些发现意味着：（1）资本-劳动比对劳动价格的反应强度比对资本价格的反应强度高出40-80%；（2）增加值无法与总产出进行可分离建模；（3）历史上关于替代弹性的分歧可被重新解释为涉及外部投入的遗漏变量偏误。
title: The Factor Bias of External Inputs: Implications for Substitution between Capital and Labor
title_zh: 外部投入的要素偏向：对资本与劳动替代关系的启示

abstract: We study how employer concentration affects job design, focusing on schedule flexibility as a non-wage job attribute. Using the full text of 46 million UK job vacancies from 2014–2019, we construct new measures of flexible work arrangements using supervised machine learning and large-language-model—assisted annotations. Adopting an instrumental variable strategy using a Bartik-style prediction of the change in employer concentration based on nationwide hiring trends, we show that higher concentration reduces the value of worker compensation partly through shifts toward “risky” flexibility that exposes workers to earnings volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了雇主集中度如何影响工作设计，重点关注作为非工资性工作属性的排班灵活性。利用2014-2019年间4600万条英国职位空缺的全文数据，我们通过监督式机器学习与大语言模型辅助标注，构建了灵活工作安排的新测度。采用工具变量策略——基于全国招聘趋势对雇主集中度变化进行巴蒂克式预测——我们发现，更高的集中度会通过转向使工人面临收入波动的“风险型”灵活性，部分降低工人薪酬价值。
title: Firm Concentration and Job Design: The Case of Schedule Flexible Work Arrangements
title_zh: 企业集中度与工作设计：以弹性工时安排为例

abstract: We study the unintended effects of Fair Access to Insurance Requirements (FAIR) plans developed by 26 states in the 1960s to address insurance redlining in urban neighborhoods. FAIR plans’ problematic features included prohibitions on considering environmental hazards in underwriting, mandatory insurer participation in pools that diluted underwriting incentives, and payouts exceeding market values in declining areas. Using a triple-difference design comparing pre/post-FAIR periods, neighborhoods with/without likely FAIR access, and participating/non-participating states, we find that FAIR inadvertently led to significant housing disinvestment and accelerated declines in neighborhood population, with simultaneous increases in the Black population share.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60年代美国26个州为应对城市社区保险红线歧视而制定的《公平保险准入要求》（FAIR）计划所产生的非预期效应。FAIR计划的问题特征包括：禁止在承保中考虑环境危害、强制保险公司参与稀释承保激励的共保池，以及赔付金额超过衰退区域的市场价值。通过采用三重差分设计——比较FAIR实施前后时期、可能获得FAIR准入的社区与未获得社区、参与州与非参与州——我们发现FAIR计划意外导致了显著的住房投资减少，加速了社区人口下降，同时黑人人口占比同步上升。
title: The Bronx Is Burning: Urban Disinvestment Effects of Fair Access to Insurance Requirements Plans
title_zh: 布朗克斯在燃烧：公平保险准入计划的城市撤资效应

abstract: We study how public disclosure of politicians’ outside income affects their behavior. We exploit a disclosure reform targeting German federal MPs and tax-return data in a difference-indifferences setup using unaffected state MPs as controls. MPs increase their outside income by 24%, driven by likely right-leaning MPs. A representative survey experiment uncovers that right-leaning voters interpret outside income as a signal of competence and hard work, while left-leaning voters associate it with weaker representation. Consistent with this, we show that newspapers cover right-leaning MPs’ outside activities more favorably. Our findings suggest that politicians strategically use public disclosure as a signaling tool.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政治家外部收入的公开披露如何影响其行为。利用一项针对德国联邦议会议员的披露改革及纳税申报数据，在双重差分框架下以未受影响的州议会议员作为对照组进行分析。研究发现，议员的院外收入增加了24%，这一增长主要由倾向右翼的议员驱动。一项代表性调查实验揭示，右翼选民将外部收入视为能力与勤奋的信号，而左翼选民则将其与代表性不足相关联。与此一致的是，我们发现报纸对右翼议员外部活动的报道更为正面。研究结果表明，政治家会策略性地将公开披露作为信号传递工具。
title: Outside Income as a Signal: Evidence from Politicians and Voters
title_zh: 外部收入作为信号：来自政治家与选民的证据

abstract: This paper studies gender differences in educational attainment and labor market outcomes. Across 21 OECD countries, though men are paid more than women, the college attainment rates and college premia are (mostly) higher for women. This paper explains these patterns through the quantitative analysis of a dynamic choice model of education and labor market outcomes. Using the estimated model, we decompose the observed gender gaps through a series of counterfactual exercises. One finding is that these gaps are driven mainly by gender differences in the average compensation at non-college jobs. The estimated lower compensation for non-college women generates for them larger college premia and higher incentives to attend college relative to men. A second finding, through the lens of the estimated model, is that observed gender wage gaps for college workers are largely driven by differences in the gender specific distributions across signals of ability rather than wage differences across genders given a signal.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了教育成就与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异。在21个OECD国家中，尽管男性薪酬高于女性，但女性的大学入学率及大学教育溢价（大多）更高。本文通过构建教育与劳动力市场结果的动态选择模型并进行量化分析，解释了上述模式。基于估计模型，我们通过一系列反事实模拟分解了观察到的性别差距。研究发现之一：这些差距主要由非大学职业中男女平均薪酬差异驱动。非大学职业女性薪酬较低，导致其大学教育溢价更高，且相较于男性更倾向于接受高等教育。研究发现之二：通过估计模型的视角，大学劳动者的性别工资差距主要源于不同能力信号在性别分布上的差异，而非给定信号下性别间的工资差异。
title: Determining Gender Differences in Education and Labor Market Outcomes
title_zh: 确定教育与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异

abstract: We study on-platform tying by a dominant platform that controls a primary access point and operates an adjacent specialised service. A rival service can reach users both through the dominant platform and through a direct channel. In a two-sided market where platforms charge sellers and seller participation affects consumer demand, tying improves the integrated service, but also shifts demand away from the rival. We show that lower mediated demand reduces seller participation on the rival platform, weakening the rival also for users who access it directly. As a result, tying can reduce consumer surplus and welfare once the direct channel is sufficiently large. We also compare tying with demotion and with a common-access policy, and show that our main insights carry over to a one-sided model in which network effects operate among consumers who pay directly for the specialised service.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一家主导平台在控制主要接入点并运营相邻专业化服务时的平台内捆绑行为。竞争性服务既可通过主导平台触达用户，也可通过直接渠道触达用户。在平台向卖家收费且卖家参与影响消费者需求的双边市场中，捆绑行为虽能提升整合服务的质量，但也会导致需求从竞争平台转移。研究表明，中介需求的降低会减少竞争平台上的卖家参与，从而削弱该平台对直接访问用户的吸引力。因此，当直接渠道规模足够大时，捆绑行为可能降低消费者剩余和社会福利。我们还将捆绑行为与降级处理及公共接入政策进行了比较，并证明主要结论可延伸至网络效应作用于直接为专业化服务付费的消费者之间的单边模型。
title: Platform Tying and its Effects
title_zh: 平台捆绑及其影响

abstract: We measure the nature and severity of a variety of belief distortions in market reactions to hundreds of economic news events by synthesizing structural estimation with algorithmic machine learning to quantify bias. We find that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks, a phenomenon we show often dampens rather than amplifies market volatility via a “shock composition effect.” Such effects imply that the stock market can underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks. (JEL E7, E27, E32, E17, G4)
abstract_zh: 我们通过将结构估计与算法机器学习相结合，量化了市场对数百个经济新闻事件反应中多种信念扭曲的性质与严重程度。研究发现，投资者系统性地对多重基本面冲击的感知过度反应，这一现象通常通过“冲击构成效应”抑制而非放大市场波动。此类效应表明，即使投资者对所有冲击均过度反应，股票市场仍可能对新闻反应不足。（JEL分类号：E7, E27, E32, E17, G4）
title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
title_zh: 数百个经济新闻事件揭示的股市信念过度反应

abstract: Which countries drive global inequality? Which states drive US inequality? We characterize the class of inequality measures that can answer these questions, permitting both an additive decomposition by subgroup and a multiplicative decomposition into within- and between-group components. Its central measure is simply the expected ratio of incomes between two randomly selected individuals. We show that global inequality fell since 1990, driven by declining disparities between countries. Inequality is primarily driven by large middle-income countries (India, China) and poor countries (Democratic Republic of Congo, Ethiopia). In the US, rising inequality is explained by widening gaps within states, while between-state inequality remains limited.
abstract_zh: 哪些国家推动了全球不平等？哪些州推动了美国不平等？我们刻画了能够回答这些问题的不平等度量类别，这类度量既允许按子群进行加性分解，也允许分解为组内和组间成分的乘性结构。其核心度量指标简化为随机选取两个个体收入比值的期望值。研究表明，自1990年以来，全球不平等程度有所下降，这主要源于国家间差距的缩小。不平等的主要驱动因素来自大型中等收入国家（印度、中国）和贫困国家（刚果民主共和国、埃塞俄比亚）。在美国，不平等加剧的原因在于各州内部差距的扩大，而州际不平等程度仍然有限。
china_relevance_reason: 中国仅作为全球不平等分析中的案例之一，并非核心研究对象、数据或政策背景
title: Who drives inequality?
title_zh: 谁在驱动不平等？

abstract: We study maximum resale prices across heterogeneous local markets that share a common target retail price. A sufficiently small retailer margin can make the ceiling bind across markets, allowing common terms to implement this price. Two-part tariffs instead require the marginal wholesale price to align the retailer’s unconstrained optimal price exactly with the target. If the ceiling already binds, changes in market structure require no contractual recalibration. Apple’s use of list prices as de facto maximum resale prices, combined with discounts from those prices for independent resellers, illustrates a setting in which the mechanism may be relevant.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在共享统一目标零售价格的异质性地方市场中，最高转售价格的表现。当零售商利润率足够低时，价格上限可能在各市场间产生约束效应，使得统一条款能够实现该目标价格。相比之下，两部收费制要求边际批发价格精确匹配零售商无约束最优价格与目标价格。若价格上限已产生约束，市场结构变化无需重新调整合同条款。苹果公司将标价作为事实上的最高转售价格，同时为独立经销商提供折扣的做法，揭示了该机制可能适用的场景。
title: Maximum resale prices across heterogeneous local markets
title_zh: 异质地方市场中的最高转售价格

abstract: In the context of school choice, Ergin (2002) shows that Pareto efficiency and group strategy-proofness are equivalent properties for the student-optimal stable mechanism. We show that this equivalence holds at each preference profile and for every stable mechanism, providing a simple test for coalitional manipulability.
abstract_zh: 在学校选择的背景下，Ergin（2002）指出，对于学生最优稳定机制而言，帕累托效率与群体策略防伪性是等价的。我们证明，这种等价性在每个偏好分布下以及对于每一种稳定机制均成立，从而为联盟可操纵性提供了一种简单的检验方法。
title: On the inefficiency and coalitional manipulability of stable mechanisms
title_zh: 论稳定机制的低效率与联盟可操纵性

abstract: Non-financial risks affect asset prices individually, yet they are typically studied in isolation. Using 49 Fama–French industry portfolios over 1990–2026, we show that pairwise compound channels among geopolitical risk, climate policy uncertainty, and financial stress carry significant pricing power beyond individual exposures. Climate policy uncertainty emerges as the nexus variable: its interaction with financial conditions is the most consistent channel, surviving all standard error methods, sub-sample splits, and predetermined (lagged) financial conditions, with an effect roughly four times larger for carbon-intensive industries. A Wald test confirms the joint significance of the interactions while individual risks lack joint significance.
abstract_zh: 非金融风险虽各自影响资产价格，但通常被孤立研究。基于1990-2026年49个Fama-French行业投资组合，我们发现地缘政治风险、气候政策不确定性与金融压力之间的两两复合渠道，其定价能力显著超越单一风险暴露。气候政策不确定性作为枢纽变量：其与金融状况的交互作用是最稳健的渠道，在所有标准误方法、子样本分割及预设（滞后）金融状况下均保持显著，且对碳密集型行业的影响约为其他行业的四倍。Wald检验证实交互项具有联合显著性，而单一风险则缺乏联合显著性。
title: Do non-financial risks compound? Evidence from U.S. industry returns
title_zh: 非金融风险会叠加吗？来自美国行业回报的证据

abstract: This paper unifies public choice and public finance accounts of the flypaper effect under fiscal capacity as a common moderator, thereby organizing previously separate explanations into a single comparative-static framework. Using panel data on Chilean municipalities (2001–2021), we find that the flypaper response declines monotonically with fiscal capacity, from a transfer elasticity of 0.92 in the lowest-capacity quintile to statistical indistinguishability from zero in the highest; own-revenue elasticities show the opposite pattern. The gradient is robust to controls for municipality size and across alternative specifications. We read it as a regime statistic of a permanent institutional configuration with centrally fixed tax rates and formula-based intergovernmental grants, not as a treatment effect. The framework integrates the marginal cost of public funds from public finance with electoral accountability and soft budget constraints from public choice, each yielding the same prediction of monotonic decline. Uniform allocation rules amplify rather than neutralize the asymmetries they were designed to address, with implications for the design of intergovernmental transfer systems in developing countries.

abstract_zh: 本文将公共选择与公共财政对粘蝇纸效应的解释统一于财政能力这一共同调节变量之下，从而将此前相互独立的解释整合至一个比较静态分析框架中。利用智利市政当局的面板数据（2001-2021年），我们发现粘蝇纸效应随财政能力单调递减：在财政能力最低的五分之一组中，转移支付弹性为0.92，而在最高组中，该弹性在统计上与零无显著差异；自有收入弹性则呈现相反模式。这一梯度关系在控制市政规模变量及采用不同模型设定后依然稳健。我们将其解读为一种制度配置的体制性统计特征——该配置包含中央固定税率与基于公式的政府间转移支付——而非处理效应。该框架将公共财政中的公共资金边际成本与公共选择中的选举问责及软预算约束相整合，三者均得出单调递减的相同预测。统一分配规则非但未能抵消其旨在解决的不对称性，反而加剧了这种不对称，这对发展中国家政府间转移支付体系的设计具有启示意义。本文为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以获取访问权限。

title: Fiscal capacity and the flypaper effect

abstract: Focus Stablecoins – digital tokens with the goal to function as money – offer easy access to US dollar liquidity. As a result, one of the main use cases of stablecoins to date has been to serve as a store of value in emerging market and developing economies. However, relatively little is known about the drivers and behaviour of "stablecoin dollarisation", how it may interact with more conventional forms of dollarisation and how it may affect monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 焦点稳定币——旨在充当货币的数字代币——为获取美元流动性提供了便捷渠道。因此，稳定币迄今的主要应用场景之一，是在新兴市场和发展中经济体充当价值储存手段。然而，关于"稳定币美元化"的驱动因素与行为特征、其与传统美元化形式的潜在互动机制，以及可能对货币政策产生的影响，目前仍知之甚少。
title: Dollarisation and monetary control: what lessons for the rise of stablecoins?
title_zh: 美元化与货币控制：稳定币崛起带来了哪些启示？

abstract: Adoption of organic certification across the EU remains lower than anticipated, with financial risks during and after conversion often cited as barriers. We examine whether farms with stronger financial health (FH) are associated with a higher likelihood of adopting organic certification. Using Farm Accountancy Data Network panel data from 2014 to 2018 covering 24,797 EU farms, we classify farms by FH and apply matching and logit regression to analyse the relationship between preconversion FH and organic certification adoption. Results show no clear association between FH and adoption, while preconversion land-use intensity consistently correlates with organic certification uptake, suggesting relevance for EU policy design efforts.
abstract_zh: 欧盟范围内有机认证的采用率仍低于预期，转型期间及之后的财务风险常被视为障碍。本文探究财务健康状况更佳的农场是否更有可能采用有机认证。基于2014至2018年覆盖24,797个欧盟农场的农场会计数据网络面板数据，我们对农场进行财务健康分类，并运用匹配法和逻辑回归分析转型前财务健康与有机认证采用之间的关系。结果显示，财务健康与有机认证采用之间无显著关联，而转型前土地利用强度始终与有机认证采用呈正相关，这一发现对欧盟政策设计具有参考价值。
title: Deep pockets needed? Financial health and organic certification adoption in the European Union
title_zh: 资金充裕是必需的吗？欧盟有机认证采纳中的财务状况研究

abstract: Mergers are associated with large and persistent earnings declines for incumbent employees in target firms. Linking employer‐employee administrative data with information on merger activity in Brazil, I find the negative effects concentrate on employees who exit target firms and reflect displacement in the short run and wage declines in the long run. Low‐skilled, managerial, and older employees fare worse. Overall, I conclude that mergers are followed by substantial reallocation costs reflecting losses of firm‐specific wage premiums, matching inefficiencies, and industry‐specific human capital depreciation, with employees transitioning to lower paying firms considered to be of lower productivity and employment value.
abstract_zh: 并购与目标企业现有员工的大幅且持续的收入下降相关。通过将巴西雇主-雇员行政数据与并购活动信息相关联，我发现负面效应主要集中在离职的目标企业员工身上，这既反映了短期内的岗位流失，也体现了长期内的工资下降。低技能、管理岗位及年长员工受到的影响更为严重。总体而言，我得出结论：并购之后会出现显著的重新配置成本，这反映了企业特定工资溢价的损失、匹配效率低下以及行业特定人力资本的贬值，员工转而流向被认为生产率和就业价值较低的低薪企业。
title: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
title_zh: 并购、员工成本与劳动力再配置

abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents' partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 责任清晰性是政治问责的核心要素。我们构建了一个存在模糊归因情境下贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并通过原创性调查检验其预测。研究表明，受访者的党派倾向、对公共医疗质量的评估以及关于哪级政府负责医疗服务的信念之间存在预测性关联：评估良好的选民将责任归于其偏好政党执政的层级，而评估不佳的选民则将责任归咎于其厌恶政党执政的层级。这种党派性的褒贬模式常被解读为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据，但在归因模糊条件下，它实际上可能源于理性贝叶斯更新。当同一政党同时掌控地区与中央政府时，此类党派性模式便不复存在。在告知受访者官方医疗质量信息的调查实验中，其更新方向与预测的党派性方向一致。模型与实证结果表明，当归因模糊时，党派先验信念极难被撼动。
title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 模糊归因：理论与证据

abstract: I develop a method that uses the language surrounding places, people, and other entities in dated text to measure their attributes over time, and use it to ask whether a local orientation toward useful knowledge predicts innovation and growth. Patterns of word use form a numerical map, or word embedding, in which fixed word lists define attribute scales for scoring each entity. Neither scales nor scores use outcomes, and publication dates restrict scores to prior text. Applied to 38.6 billion context-word occurrences in nearly 2.7 million English-language works from 1500-1899, the method recovers independently measured elevation and agricultural dependence and combines learning, science, practical improvement, and print in a useful-knowledge index. Within countries, a one-standard-deviation increase in the index is associated with 0.105 standard deviations higher log(1+patents) during 1980-2014 and a 3.4 percentage-point increase in the probability of any patent. The association remains 0.062 standard deviations in 7,011 cells without a recorded birthplace of a notable intellectual. An index reconstructed from pre-1750 contexts predicts 1980-2014 log patenting within countries at 0.053 standard deviations after controlling for textual coverage, with positive estimates in Europe, Asia, and Latin America. Training the embedding solely on pre-1750 text leaves the full-sample association positive. Within countries, the 1500-1899 index also predicts average nighttime light over 1992-2024 and regional GDP per capita in each region's latest available year, 2016-2020. In European cities, the pre-1750 index predicts faster post-1750 growth near coal, a complementarity concentrated in Britain. The findings support Mokyr's view of useful knowledge as a local innovative capacity and an Allen-Mokyr synthesis for Britain's coal-and-steam take-off.
abstract_zh: 我提出一种方法，利用文本中围绕地点、人物及其他实体的语言，测量其随时间变化的属性，并以此探究对实用知识的地方性取向能否预测创新与增长。词汇使用模式构成数值化地图（即词嵌入），其中固定词表定义属性标尺，用于对每个实体进行评分。标尺与评分均不依赖结果变量，且出版日期将评分限定于历史文本。将该方法应用于1500-1899年间近270万部英文著作中的386亿个上下文词汇实例后，该方法成功还原了独立测量的海拔高度与农业依赖度，并将学习、科学、实践改进与印刷术整合为实用知识指数。在国家层面，该指数每增加一个标准差，1980-2014年间log(1+专利数)提高0.105个标准差，且产生任何专利的概率上升3.4个百分点。在7011个未记录著名知识分子出生地的单元格中，该关联仍保持0.062个标准差。基于1750年前文本重建的指数，在控制文本覆盖范围后，可预测1980-2014年国家内log专利数达0.053个标准差，且欧洲、亚洲与拉丁美洲均呈现正向估计值。仅以1750年前文本训练词嵌入后，全样本关联仍保持正向。在国家层面，1500-1899年指数还可预测1992-2024年平均夜间灯光强度，以及各地区最新可用年份（2016-2020年）的区域人均GDP。在欧洲城市中，1750年前指数可预测1750年后煤炭资源附近更快的增长，这种互补性集中体现在英国。研究结果支持Mokyr关于实用知识作为地方创新能力的观点，以及英国煤炭与蒸汽腾飞的Allen-Mokyr综合解释。
title: Measuring the Culture of Useful Knowledge and the Roots of Innovation
title_zh: 衡量有用知识文化及创新根源

abstract: Using the universe of incorporated firms in the United Kingdom, we document that long term debt that is not secured by specific corporate assets (commonly referred to as cash-flow-based debt) is ubiquitous, even among very young firms. Consistent with cash-flow-based lending depending on firms' continuation value, both the timing and the amount of cash-flow-based debt at first financing are strongly related to future performance. In fact, the age at which firms first access cash-flow-based long-term debt is a strong predictor of firm outcomes up to twenty years later. In contrast, the age at which firms access asset-based lending does not predict future performance. To understand how lending based on continuation value impacts firm dynamics, we develop a tractable theory of firm life cycle dynamics with permanent heterogeneity and financing frictions -- where access to finance can be based on signals of both current and future performance. The model highlights the importance of financing based on future value in matching the predictability of cash-flow-based financing observed in the data. It also highlights how frictions to financing based on available collateral vs. future value lead to differential selection and hence very different distributions of firms that survive and grow. The degree to which firms can access financing based on future value is therefore fundamentally intertwined with aggregate firm dynamics.
abstract_zh: 基于英国全部注册公司的数据，我们发现未以特定企业资产担保的长期债务（通常称为现金流债务）普遍存在，即便是非常年轻的企业也不例外。与现金流贷款依赖企业持续经营价值这一逻辑一致，首次融资时现金流债务的时机和规模均与未来业绩密切相关。事实上，企业首次获得现金流长期债务的年龄，能够强有力地预测其后长达二十年的经营表现。相比之下，企业首次获得资产担保贷款的年龄则无法预测未来业绩。为理解基于持续经营价值的贷款如何影响企业动态，我们构建了一个包含永久异质性和融资摩擦的企业生命周期动态理论模型——其中融资可得性可同时基于当前业绩和未来业绩的信号。该模型凸显了基于未来价值的融资在匹配数据中观察到的现金流融资可预测性方面的重要性，同时揭示了基于现有抵押品与基于未来价值的融资摩擦如何导致差异化选择，进而形成截然不同的存活与成长企业分布。因此，企业基于未来价值获取融资的能力与总体企业动态存在根本性关联。
title: The Nature of Firm Financing and Growth

abstract: As the postwar international order fragments and universal agreement becomes increasingly elusive, policymakers face a pressing question: what form of cooperation can replace the postwar hegemon-led, rules-based system? This column examines two complementary answers. Mark Carney argues that coalitions of middle powers can preserve stability, resilience, and strategic autonomy in an era of great-power rivalry. The author of this column proposes a broader architecture of pivotal power coalitions organised around human flourishing, policy alignment, and polycentric governance. Their dialogue illuminates one of the defining policy challenges of our time: how to combine geopolitical realism with effective collective action. Together, these approaches offer a practical roadmap for building a more resilient, cooperative, and problem-solving world order.
abstract_zh: 随着战后国际秩序碎片化，普遍共识愈发难以达成，政策制定者面临一个紧迫问题：何种合作形式能够取代战后由霸权主导、基于规则的国际体系？本专栏探讨了两种互补的答案。马克·卡尼认为，中等强国联盟可以在大国竞争时代维护稳定、韧性与战略自主。本专栏作者则提出一个更宏大的架构，即围绕人类繁荣、政策趋同与多中心治理构建关键力量联盟。两者的对话揭示了当代最具挑战性的政策议题之一：如何将地缘政治现实主义与有效的集体行动相结合。这些路径共同为构建更具韧性、更富合作精神且能有效解决问题的世界秩序提供了切实可行的路线图。
title: Rebuilding the world order: Two strategies for a fragmented world
title_zh: 重建世界秩序：碎片化世界的两种策略

abstract: This paper estimates the medium-run effects, 4.5 years after launch, of a regularization program that granted temporary legal status, freedom of movement, work authorization, and access to social programs to nearly half a million Venezuelan forced migrants in Colombia with no criminal record. Because the program was announced unexpectedly and applied retroactively to migrants who had registered in a census before a sharp eligibility cutoff, the paper identifies its effects using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design and a unique two-wave panel survey. The largest medium-run gains were in social capital. At the cutoff, eligible migrants scored 0.95 standard deviation higher than ineligible peers on a social integration index capturing belonging, friendships with Colombians, community participation, and attachment to Colombia, and 0.97 standard deviation higher on a prosocial behavior index measuring generalized trust and trust toward both Colombians and Venezuelans. Neither effect is detectable in the short run, and both emerge only over time. Economic gains, by contrast, arose immediately and largely persisted. Eligible migrants earned 69 percent higher monthly labor income, scored 2.6 standard deviations higher on a service access index, and made substantial investments in housing, with housing quality increasing from 0.60 to 1.27 standard deviations between survey waves. The implied fiscal savings to Colombia also increased over time, rising from roughly 40 to 70 percent of the fiscal cost associated with irregular households as beneficiaries moved toward fiscal balance. These findings suggest that the largest social capital and fiscal returns to regularization accrued gradually through sustained legal inclusion and repeated positive interactions with institutions and host communities rather than through the act of legalization itself.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了一项合法化计划在启动四年半后的中期效应。该计划向近50万在哥伦比亚无犯罪记录的委内瑞拉被迫移民授予临时合法身份、自由迁徙权、工作许可及社会项目准入资格。由于该计划系突然宣布，且对在严格资格截止日期前完成人口普查登记的移民具有追溯效力，本文利用模糊断点回归设计及独特的两轮面板调查数据识别其影响。中期最大收益体现在社会资本领域：在断点处，符合资格的移民在社会融合指数（涵盖归属感、与哥伦比亚人的友谊、社区参与及对哥伦比亚的依恋）上得分比不符合资格的同伴高0.95个标准差，在亲社会行为指数（衡量普遍信任及对哥伦比亚人与委内瑞拉人的信任）上得分高0.97个标准差。这两种效应在短期内均不可观测，且随时间推移才逐渐显现。相比之下，经济收益则立即产生并基本持续：符合资格的移民月劳动收入高出69%，服务获取指数得分高出2.6个标准差，并在住房方面进行大量投资，住房质量在两轮调查间从0.60个标准差提升至1.27个标准差。哥伦比亚的隐含财政节约也随时间增长，随着受益者逐步实现财政平衡，从约占非正规家庭相关财政成本的40%上升至70%。这些发现表明，合法化带来的最大社会资本与财政回报是通过持续的法律包容及与制度、东道社区的反复积极互动逐步累积的，而非源于合法化行为本身。

abstract: This paper, based on the Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture that the author delivered at the Annual Bank Conference on Development Economics (ABCDE) 2026, examines two structural impediments to broad-based economic development: dysfunctional central bank currency systems and inadequately resolved sovereign debt burdens. On currency, the paper argues that floating exchange rate regimes and multiple exchange rate systems—as practiced in countries such as Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Egypt—systematically transfer wealth from low-income wage earners to a narrow-privileged class, deepening poverty rather than alleviating it. Using Ethiopia as a central case study, the paper documents how successive devaluations have raised the national poverty rate from 33 percent in 2016 to a projected 43 percent by 2025, while eroding the real value of development assistance disbursed in local currency. The paper proposes that currency stabilization, low-cost digital payment infrastructure, and unsterilized central bank intervention offer a more direct path to rising median incomes than current IMF-endorsed exchange rate flexibility. On sovereign debt, the paper evaluates the performance of the G20 Common Framework and the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable against the benchmark of the 1989 Brady Plan, finding that contemporary frameworks have generated intensive creditor engagement but minimal net present value reduction for debtor countries. Key failures identified include the absence of a single comparable discount rate for measuring debt relief, incomplete participation by China and commercial creditors, growing opacity in collateralized sovereign transactions, and the risks posed by value recovery instruments to the durability of restructuring agreements. The paper concludes that neither the Common Framework nor the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable, in their current forms, are fit for purpose, and calls for replacement frameworks that prioritize measurable median income gains over creditor accommodation. Absent reforms on both fronts, per capita income growth in low-income developing economies is projected to remain at approximately 2 percent annually, leaving 5.6 billion people with incomes less than one-tenth of those in advanced economies and widening the global development gap.
abstract_zh: 本文基于作者在2026年发展经济学年度银行会议（ABCDE）上发表的斯坦利·费希尔纪念演讲，探讨了阻碍广泛经济发展的两大结构性障碍：功能失调的央行货币体系与未充分解决的主权债务负担。在货币方面，本文指出，浮动汇率制度及多重汇率体系——如埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚和埃及等国所实行的制度——系统性地将财富从低收入工薪阶层转移至少数特权阶层，加剧而非缓解贫困。以埃塞俄比亚为核心案例，本文记录了连续贬值如何使全国贫困率从2016年的33%上升至2025年预计的43%，同时侵蚀了以本币拨付的发展援助的实际价值。本文提出，相较于当前国际货币基金组织认可的汇率弹性政策，货币稳定、低成本数字支付基础设施及未冲销的央行干预措施，为提升中位收入提供了更直接的路径。在主权债务方面，本文以1989年布雷迪计划为基准，评估了二十国集团共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议的表现，发现当代框架虽促成了密集的债权人参与，但对债务国而言净现值削减微乎其微。识别出的关键失败包括：缺乏衡量债务减免的统一可比贴现率、中国及商业债权人参与不完整、抵押主权交易日益不透明，以及价值回收工具对重组协议持久性构成的威胁。本文结论认为，共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议目前的形式均不适用，并呼吁建立以可衡量的中位收入增长而非债权人妥协为核心的替代框架。若这两方面改革缺失，低收入发展中经济体的人均收入增长预计将维持在每年约2%的水平，导致56亿人口的收入不足发达经济体的十分之一，从而扩大全球发展差距。

abstract: Can energy-rich developing countries convert cheap electricity into AI compute exports? This paper develops a capacity-constrained trade model of AI compute services with bilateral frictions in delivery, regulation, and trust. Calibrating the model across 85 countries shows that several developing economies can produce compute at low cost, but this advantage rarely becomes export competitiveness. Because hardware dominates unit costs and is globally priced, cross-country production costs differ by only 12–20 percent. Modest regulatory, financing, and trust frictions can therefore erase the gains from cheap power. The binding constraint is institutional credibility rather than electricity prices, including enforceable data governance, stable regulation, credible power contracts, access to finance, and geopolitical alignment with buyers.
abstract_zh: 能源丰富的发展中国家能否将廉价电力转化为人工智能算力出口？本文构建了一个受容量约束的人工智能算力服务贸易模型，该模型纳入了交付、监管和信任方面的双边摩擦。通过对85个国家的模型校准发现，部分发展中经济体能够以低成本生产算力，但这种优势很少能转化为出口竞争力。由于硬件成本在单位成本中占主导地位且具有全球统一定价特征，各国间生产成本差异仅为12%-20%。因此，适度的监管、融资和信任摩擦足以抵消廉价电力带来的收益。制约发展的关键因素并非电价，而是制度可信度，包括可执行的数据治理、稳定的监管环境、可靠的电力合同、融资渠道以及与买方的地缘政治协调。
